own_prior_findings.original_defect: An accepted live Available observation could update quota windows while the same Unit/watch remained WaitingQuota and Workflow never restored its phase Task state before terminal.

evidence.detail: Private Immediate transaction validates exact current execution authority and active same-provider/owner-epoch lease, derives the lease account, requires accepted Available for every participating bucket, and changes only the same live quota-waiting Unit to Running with no wait reason. Input, worktree, native/finalization flags and lease/probe ownership are retained.

Owned Claude observations accumulate finite participating buckets. Available invokes durable recovery and publishes the returned Unit authority/wait reason to the same watch, clearing the quota diagnostic when recovered.

After existing identity/persisted-status validation, live quota state waits. A nonterminal same managed status with no wait reason restores a WaitingQuota Task to phase.task_state and returns Running without adding/replacing an attempt.

Preterminal recovery barrier checks accepted windows, watch/status/ledger wait removal, Running, unchanged Session/generation/worktree, open native/finalization flags, no work result and exactly one native_input; sibling ledger equality is checked after terminal.

Actual registry/adapter/Engine consumer fixture first verifies retained quota wait and one input, then releases the fresh-window recovery barrier and checks nonterminal Running/Implementing with identical execution identity, active index and history length; cancellation remains independently asserted.

additional_verified_correction.description: Claude telemetry-only quota waiting no longer creates recovery-probe authority; explicit owned Codex willRetry remains a separate transition.

evidence.detail: mark_execution_quota_wait selects native_retry=false. Only the true branch may assign probe_unit, and that branch rejects non-Codex providers. Both retain the same live turn and current authority.

Codex retry transition requires exact owned thread/turn structured subscription error with willRetry=true. Claude owned recognized telemetry calls the non-probe wait transition. Foreign Claude session events are ignored before pool mutation.

Existing accepted-window policy still rejects an unsolicited same-window Available while previous exhaustion is unexpired; recovery needs an actual admitted probe or a distinct window after the old reset. No new wait-derived probe bypass remains.

Committed controls cover rejected same-window Available, unrelated bucket, foreign/unknown events, work failure versus quota interruption, success despite exhausted telemetry, no telemetry-created probe, sibling continuity and no resent input. These assertions were read, not executed.

record.contract_consistency: R5 requires recognized subscription exhaustion to wait without work failure, continuation of the same retrying turn, reported reset/fresh metadata or bounded recovery, unrelated progress and cancellability. The fixed flow retains work/cleanup independence and does not fabricate subscription balance or new input admission.
